title: Systemic Tau: A Topological Framework for Early Warning Signals in Complex Systems

creators.name: Padilla-Villanueva, Johel
creators.affiliation: University of Puerto Rico, Medical Sciences Campus

description:
Systemic Tau (systemictau-web) is a Streamlit application for computing Systemic Tau (τs) and Discrete Extramental Clock (RECD) analyses on time series, aimed at detecting structural transitions and early warning signals in complex non-linear systems. Its Numba-optimized backend (systemictau/) includes topology, ordinal-memory and analysis modules; sample data (e.g., DengAI) and a PDF report exporter are included.

Run with pip install -r requirements.txt and streamlit run app.py.
